owner_direction: Both deeper relieved versions are the decisive choices: the full face and the reduced outer face for a smaller printer bed. The shorter 12 mm collar may remain optional.
depth_explanation: Both primary forms have a 24 mm maximum collar depth and 32 mm overall height including the 8 mm face. Each retains a continuous front 12 mm molding band, with rear clearance reliefs above it. This is different from the optional short D12 model, which has a 12 mm collar and 20 mm overall height.
small_face_explanation: The 192.55 mm diameter halves the minimum radial face width outside the unchanged collar, from 47.45 to 23.725 mm; it does not halve the complete diameter.
handoff: Deliver both primary designs. Print quantities are agreed at the printer; formats are alternatives, not separate objects. Do not substitute the optional short form by default.
historical_selection: Older RF03 recommended/D12 and OPTIONAL_DEEPER/PRINT_INSTEAD labels describe the earlier selection only. This record governs the current printer handoff.
release: Temporary tooling only; existing physical seating, bracing, release and repair checks still apply. No permanent installation release.
